description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for managing 'Meal' entities within a web application. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and managing dishes associated with meals, as well as handling related web requests and responses.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Meal
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for handling meal-related web actions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new meal related to a project, using data from the request body.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a meal by ID for subsequent actions, or detaches if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the name and comment of an existing meal.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a meal if it is deletable; otherwise, reports an error.

methods.name: delete_dishes
methods.description: Deletes dishes associated with a meal.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the project edit page.
